contract.child_policy_text: JP sheet: "Child policy / Higher category supplements will be as per All market contract". All-market contract (Luxury Reserves sheet p.7): Child Policy - (Maximum Up to 02 Children): Age of 0-5 Free of Charge. Age of 6-11.99: USD 30 (Per Child/Per Night on BB including Extra Bed), USD 50 (Per Child/Per Night on HB including Extra Bed) (Not Applicable for Triple Occupancy); USD 10 (Per Child/Per Night on BB excluding Extra Bed), USD 30 (Per Child/Per Night on HB excluding Extra bed). Baby cot can be provided on request - Free of Charge (Up to one cot per room).
contract.guide_policy_text: Tour Leader - 20% dc on Guest rate (Single accommodation). Guide Policy - Please note that we will not accommodate guides from 20th Dec to 15th March 2027 . Also No guide accommodation at Jetwing Kandy Gallery/ Jetwing Kaduruketha through out the season. 15 paying pax in the group Guide accommodation on Complimentary (Basis booked). If not, the following rates will apply: BB Single – USD 70/ HB Single – USD 90/FB Single – USD 105. (Japanese-market sheet)
contract.foc_policy_text: We will not provide complimentary accommodation on the above rates. (Japanese-market sheet)
contract.cancellation_text: JP sheet: "Cancellation policy as per All market contract". All-market contract: Cancellations within 07 days of the arrival date – 100% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 14 days of the arrival date – 50% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 21 days of the arrival date – 25% of the value of the booking. Group bookings, more than 8 rooms, will be liable to pay 50% of the basis booked before 30 days of arrival. No peak-period cancellation rule is printed for Kandy Gallery (the Luxury Reserves 28-day peak rule lists Vil Uyana, Lighthouse, Saman Villas and Yala only).
contract.payment_text: Not stated on the Japanese-market sheet (it refers only the child policy, higher-category supplements and cancellation policy to the All market contract).
contract.terms_text: RATES FOR JAPANESE MARKET (WINTER 2026 AND 27) — "USE THIS RATE SHEET". Rates are in USD net per double room per day on Half Board basis. Columns: (1) 01st Nov – 20th Dec 26 + Month of April 2027 | (2) 21st Dec – 10th Jan 27 + Month of Feb 2027 | (3) 11th Jan – 31st Jan 2027 + Month of March 2027. Jetwing Lake USD 200 / 300 / 240; Jetwing St Andrew's (Superior Room) USD 200 / 260 / 220; Jetwing St Andrew's (Heritage Superior Room) USD 225 / 285 / 245; Jetwing Yala USD 280 / 410 / 310; Jetwing Lighthouse USD 280 / 410 / 310; Jetwing Kandy Gallery (Bed and Breakfast) USD 250 / 400 / 300; Jetwing Blue or Beach USD 180 / 240 / 210; Jetwing Sea USD 160 / 220 / 190; Jetwing Kaduruketha (Wel Vidana) USD 225 / 340 / 225. • Single Reduction – USD 50 per room per day. • Single Reduction – USD 20 per room per day on BB (Kandy Gallery only) • Triple – Double + 70 on HB • Triple – Double + 40 on BB (Kandy Gallery Only). Applicable at all above hotels: • Child policy / Higher category supplements will be as per All market contract • Cancellation policy as per All market contract. • Tour Leader - 20% dc on Guest rate (Single accommodation) • We will not provide complimentary accommodation on the above rates • Guide Policy - Please note that we will not accommodate guides from 20th Dec to 15th March 2027 . Also No guide accommodation at Jetwing Kandy Gallery/ Jetwing Kaduruketha through out the season • 15 paying pax in the group Guide accommodation on Complimentary (Basis booked) If not, the following rates will apply • BB Single – USD 70/ HB Single – USD 90/FB Single – USD 105 | All-market check-in/check-out terms (not on the JP sheet): Check-in time is 14:00 and check-out time is 12:00 (noon). If an early check-in is required within 04 hours of the usual check-in time, 50% charge of the room rate will be applied. For late check-outs up to 04 hours past the original check-out time, a 50% room rate charge will apply. Late check outs past 04 hours will be charged for 100% room rate.
contract.notes: Transcribed from "JETWING HOTELS - Rates for Japanese Market - Winter 26-27 - USE THIS RATE SHEET.pdf" (1 page), saved to the winter RTS folder on 2 Oct 2026. Japanese-market contract (markets: JP only, priority 20 so it wins over the all-market plan for Japanese clients). The JP sheet prints USD net per double room per day on Bed and Breakfast in three grouped columns, each entered as one season with two date ranges. Base room: the JP sheet does not name the room, so the room the all-market sheet prices lowest is used — Luxury Room (16 Rooms) — BB 290 / HB 370 in 01 Nov – 25 Dec & April ("Jetwing Luxury Reserves - TA Contracted Rates - Winter 2026 & 2027.pdf", p.7). Single Reduction – USD 20 per room per day on BB (Kandy Gallery only); Triple – Double + 40 on BB (Kandy Gallery Only): SGL = DBL − 20, TPL = DBL + 40 (row notes). Anything the JP sheet does not price (other room categories, other meal plans, early-bird / value-add offers, payment terms) stays with the all-market plan for this hotel (rts_jwl_kandy_gallery, "Jetwing Luxury Reserves - TA Contracted Rates - Winter 2026 & 2027.pdf"): the rate lookup moves on to that plan when the JP plan has no row, so a higher category booked for a Japanese client is returned at the full all-market rate, not JP rate + "higher category supplement as per All market contract" — staff must adjust. For information (derived, NOT entered — the all-market sheet prints full rates, not supplements): it prices Gallery Suite (4 Rooms) USD 100 and Kandyan Suite (6 Rooms) USD 200 above Luxury Room in every period on BB and HB. Child policy: the JP sheet says "as per All market contract"; the all-market child amounts for this hotel are copied into the child rules (the lookup takes child rates only from the plan that wins the night) and quoted in the child policy text. Cancellation: "as per All market contract" — the all-market wording is quoted in the cancellation text; no cancellation rules are entered here (see the all-market plan). Payment terms: not stated on the JP sheet. Guide policy (JP sheet): "No guide accommodation at Jetwing Kandy Gallery/ Jetwing Kaduruketha through out the season" — no guide rate entered; the tour-leader 20% discount is entered (the JP sheet does not restrict it to particular hotels). "We will not provide complimentary accommodation on the above rates" → FOC policy text, no FOC rule. No gala dinner, contract date or booking window is printed (the PDF properties show 6 Mar 2026 — not printed, so contract_date left empty).
